es.q: ¿Rodáis con guion nuestro o lo escribís vosotros?
es.a: Como quieras. Si traes guion y storyboard, los rodamos tal cual. Si traes una idea en dos líneas, la escribimos y te la validamos antes de que se mueva una cámara.
Las que pactemos, y quedan escritas en el presupuesto: normalmente una sobre el primer montaje y otra sobre el cierre. Si el cliente final pide otra vuelta, se habla antes, no aparece en la factura.
Sí: 16:9, 9:16 y 1:1, con subtítulos y las duraciones que pida cada plataforma. Se pactan en el brief y van dentro del presupuesto.

es.q: ¿Podéis entregar el aftermovie al día siguiente?
es.a: Sí. Same-day edit para redes durante el evento y aftermovie en 24-48 h. El plazo se pacta en el brief y se cumple.
Sí: realización multicámara en directo, emisión a YouTube, Vimeo, LinkedIn o plataforma privada, y grabación limpia para la edición posterior.

One working day from receiving the brief. Fixed quote, shooting plan and assigned crew.

en.q: Do you shoot our script or do you write it?
en.a: Either way. If you bring a script and storyboard, we shoot them as they are. If you bring an idea in two lines, we write it and get it approved by you before a camera moves.

en.q: How many rounds of changes are included?
en.a: Whatever we agree, written into the quote: usually one on the first cut and one on the final cut. If the end client asks for another pass, we talk about it first, it does not just appear on the invoice.
Yes: 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, with subtitles and the durations each platform needs. Agreed in the brief and included in the quote.

en.q: Can you deliver the aftermovie the next day?
en.a: Yes. Same-day edit for social during the event and aftermovie in 24-48 h. The deadline is agreed in the brief and met.
Yes: multi-camera live production, streaming to YouTube, Vimeo, LinkedIn or a private platform, and a clean recording for the edit.

en.q: What do you need from the agency?
en.a: Brief, script or running order if there is one, date and where we shoot, a production contact and the client's brand guidelines. We handle the rest.
Whatever we agree. Usually the agency presents the work to its client and we stay out of sight. We only publish case studies once the end client has, and with the agency's agreement.

en.q: Do you have your own studio?
en.a: Yes, 100 m² in Seville with cyclorama, lighting and sound, for commercials, interviews and product.
